name: forecast_protocol_v2_nrt
relation_to_v1: a separate prospective CHALLENGER track; forecast_protocol_v1 (champion, data, cutoff, scoring) is unchanged
motivation: exploratory lag study on exposed data (docs/evidence/forecast/lag_study.json, nrt_vs_v1.json): spot features at a 2 h cutoff reduce rv_24 loss vs the v1 champion by -0.025 [-0.035,-0.014] (SCREEN) and -0.023 (DEV)
targets: identical to v1 (rv_24, move3_24) computed from the registered perpetual archive, so v2 and v1 forecasts are compared on the same outcomes
inputs: Binance SPOT BTCUSDT 1h klines (official public market-data endpoint data-api.binance.vision for the latest hours; official spot archives for history); only bars that closed by the cutoff
cutoff: as_of = origin - 2 h; issuance window [origin - 2 h + 5 min, origin); no issuance after the origin (missed windows recorded, never backfilled)
model: M1_logistic (v1 champion model class, same features and abstention rules) trained on spot features at the 2 h cutoff with perpetual labels that were observable at issuance
label: PROSPECTIVE challenger CH:nrt_spot_M1 (experimental); never replaces the champion automatically
input_integrity: every issuance stores the exact spot bar window (npz + sha256) and the raw API response sha256; spot bars are later re-checked against the official daily spot archive (mismatch -> alert, stored inputs kept)
